notes.title: Update V0.9
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40514930/d12cee78cd4dc411da887f844931b0509901f205.png

This update includes minor bug fixes as well as a few changes:


 Fixed issue that caused Armoury status not to be included in save game data.
 Fixed issue that caused Ammunition data for each rocket not to be included in save game data.
 Fixed issue that stopped Latency and Coverage telemetry being sent to Mission Control UI.
 Increased the regularity of asteroid spawning.
 Increased bullet speed by 20%.
 Rockets now report when they lose and re-establish connection, via the Mission Log

An unknown issue occasionally causes some rockets' transmission cone indicator to reset to a rectangle instead of a triangle still remains. Its very rare and hard to replicate. But when I find it I will do another update. 

I am waiting for one more QA from another tester. Once feedback has been received and reviewed, I will make any changes and officially set the version to 1.0, ready for release later this month.
